purpose: LLM-readable animal anatomy classification and planned cutout catalog for Frankenstein creature assembly.

conventions.data_structure: animals is a dictionary keyed by source folder; each animal has body_parts dictionaries containing arrays of part IDs. parts is a dictionary keyed by unique part ID.
conventions.laterality: left and right refer to the animal, not the viewer. Both anatomical sides are listed even when hidden in the side-view source.
conventions.counts: Anatomical counts are classification expectations, not counts of independently visible or extracted image assets.
conventions.colors: Body color tags are approximate visual descriptions of the source artwork; eye iris colors are unverified and therefore null.
conventions.not_applicable: An empty category array means that category has no applicable external part; category_notes explains alternatives.
conventions.paths: source_image paths exist in the pinned repository. All parts[*].file paths are PROPOSED relative output paths and do not yet exist.
conventions.coordinates: plug is null and sockets is empty until image segmentation and measurement; null on a non-root part means unmeasured, not unattached.
conventions.renderer_compatibility: Only the object {parts: <this document.parts>} matches structure.py PartsCatalog. The full document is a classification manifest and must not be passed directly to its extra=forbid model.
conventions.render_readiness: Do not render planned files or treat whole-animal source PNGs as cutouts. Segment parts, measure plugs/sockets and confirm visibility first.
conventions.layer: Values are suggested draw orders only; hidden limbs and camera orientation require adjustment after segmentation.

llm_instructions: Use only animal IDs and part IDs present in this catalog.
Resolve singular terms eye and ear to eyes and ears; body and torso to body; front legs and forelegs to front_legs; back legs and hind legs to back_legs.
Do not call quadruped forefeet hands. Monkey hands are separate from its arms and hind legs.
Keep fins, flippers and wings in their own categories; do not relabel them as legs or hands.
Do not confuse peacock tail eyespots with anatomical eyes.
Do not invent iris colors, cutout coordinates, visibility, or extracted file availability.
For animal-specific colors, read part_attributes; color_options are editable design choices, not verified natural colors.
Use parts tags for filtering. Use part_attributes to distinguish laterality, limb position, anatomy, parent, and source.
Lips describes a mouth-region cutout where applicable; it is not always a separately extractable structure.

category_notes.hands: No separate hands in this classification; feet remain part of legs, or appendages use animal-specific categories.
category_notes.ears: No external pinnae. Hearing anatomy is internal; no separate ear cutout is defined.
category_notes.lips: No separate mammalian-style lip asset; use mouth for the jaw and mouth region.
